d:
September is here, and with it comes a new episode of our favorite vampires! "Rangers Between Worlds"—finally, after a long time (both in the series and in real life), what Silma has been searching for has happened... She's reached the ruins of what was once her grandmother's house. Will she find the secrets there to defeat the queen? Meanwhile, in the Rangers' world, the resistance continues trying to sabotage the vampires, though they'll probably be discovered soon... I hope you enjoy it!
